name: Quote generation - 30 sheets white melamine 16mm
description: Customer requests a quote for a larger quantity of 30 sheets. AI should use generate_quote, return total and PDF link.

messages.text: My name is Test Customer, please quote me for 30 sheets of white melamine 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Tests a larger quantity (30 sheets) to verify quote generation handles bulk orders correctly.
